response.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT ts, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM b) AS share FROM b), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM k
